The use of &mut self on wasm_bindgen methods correctly delegates borrow-checking to the JS runtime without changing sequential API semantics. Serde derives deliberately establish the WidgetSpec JSON shape for create_widget_from_json, compiling cleanly on native. The pre-release gate accurately fails upon missing targets, and its receipt schema tolerates the new 'wasm32' metric seamlessly. All changes remain strictly within scope.
